description: This file defines the class 'ExtensionSet' within the Twig templating engine. It manages collections of extensions, filters, functions, tests, token parsers, and node visitors, providing functionality for initialization, extension registration, and retrieval of extension components.

classes.name: ExtensionSet
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates the logic to manage a set of Twig extensions, including their registration, initialization, and retrieval of extension components such as filters, functions, tests, token parsers, and node visitors.

methods.name: initRuntime
methods.description: Initializes the runtime environment for the extension set, marking it as runtime-initialized.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if an extension of a specific class is registered in the set.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a registered extension instance by its class name, throws an error if not found.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Sets multiple extensions at once, adding each via the addExtension method.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns all registered extensions.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Generates a JSON string signature of the registered extensions' class names.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Returns whether the extension set has been initialized.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Determines the last modification time among all registered extension files.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Registers a new extension instance, throws if extensions are already initialized or if the extension is already registered.

methods.name: addFunction
methods.description: Adds a new TwigFunction to the set, deferring if extensions are already initialized.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns all registered functions, initializing extensions if necessary.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a function by name, supporting dynamic and callback-based retrieval.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFunctionCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for handling undefined functions.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to the set, deferring if extensions are already initialized.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns all filters, initializing extensions if necessary.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a filter by name, supporting dynamic and callback-based lookup.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFilterCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for handling undefined filters.

methods.name: addNodeVisitor
methods.description: Adds a node visitor to the extension set, deferring if extensions are already initialized.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns all node visitors, initializing extensions if needed.

methods.name: addTokenParser
methods.description: Adds a token parser, deferring if extensions are already initialized.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns all token parsers, initializing extensions if needed.

methods.name: getTokenParser
methods.description: Retrieves a token parser by name, supporting callback-based retrieval.

methods.name: registerUndefinedTokenParserCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for handling undefined token parsers.

methods.name: getGlobals
methods.description: Collects global variables from extensions, caching after first computation.

methods.name: resetGlobals
methods.description: Resets cached global variables to force re-evaluation.

methods.name: addTest
methods.description: Adds a test to the extension set, with restrictions on post-initialization.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns all tests, initializing extensions if necessary.

methods.name: getTest
methods.description: Retrieves a test by name, supporting dynamic and callback-based lookup.

methods.name: getUnaryOperators
methods.description: Returns unary operator definitions, initializing extensions if needed.

methods.name: getBinaryOperators
methods.description: Returns binary operator definitions, initializing extensions if needed.

methods.name: initExtensions
methods.description: Initializes all extension components such as filters, functions, tests, token parsers, and visitors.

methods.name: initExtension
methods.description: Initializes individual extension components, including filters, functions, tests, token parsers, visitors, and operators.
